conflictsOfInterest: The founder is the project maintainer. The experiment, reproduction and closure packet are internal project work, not independent external validation.
question: La PR #171 presenta el cierre interno de M3 limitado a `anchored-sequence-v1`: clase de intercambio solapado, pruebas finitas reproducibles, límites de las afirmaciones y costes locales medidos. ¿Apruebas cerrar internamente M3 con ese alcance, dejando pendientes la validación externa, la ejecución y cualquier afirmación general o de rendimiento en producción? La decisión se registrará solo después de completar las comprobaciones de la PR.
decisionText: Sí, apruebo el cierre acotado de M3
basis: The previously approved bounded ADR 0017 and SPEC-018 experiment is preserved at spec-018-reviewed-2656924.

The merged M3 experiment was reproduced internally on develop; the rank-key oracle matched byte for byte across 19,806 orders with zero mismatches, the finite corpus had zero false certificates, and the isolated Git witness produced equal trees.
PR #171 passed local quick and PR profiles with 266 tests and four skips each, and all applicable GitHub checks passed before this decision was recorded.
limits: Closure is restricted to pure anchored-sequence-v1 inserts with immutable base/root anchors, fresh IDs and final ordered-sequence observation.
The oracle is a separate implementation by the same author and machine; producer and verifier share replay; independent external validation and formal proof review remain pending.
No general OT, contextual equivalence, confluence, Yang-Baxter, arbitrary Git patch equivalence, production performance or safe parallel execution claim follows.
No execution authorization, M3.5 training authorization or M3.5 closure follows.
